book.name: SUMBAOGHA
book.title: Allahri Imap So'oap Sumbaogha Sembe Musari Mome Toro Pibog Yubu

content: Esauri nimi liksiogne (36:1-19)
Esau si nhon Edom.

Esauri Kanaan kelabo phende topsiog. Selekne Hetne Elon elmangkel Ada tobog, phendepne Hewinge Ana elmangkel Oholibama tobog. Ana ili Sibeon. Nen nhon ma'aro wilindipne tobogne Ismael elmangkel Nebayot ilipsa'el Basmat
tobog.
Adari Elifas Esau sembe mangkarogpa, Basmatti Rehuel mangkarog.
Oholibamari Esau sembe mangkarognena: Yeus, Yaelam apna Korahap. Esau Kanaan wamogha el kelabori mabo lambare ane mangkahiek.
Esauri ilipsae Yakub laplobiagha mog so'o nhon weag palamogti, Kanaan wamogti, saeag taoghaap, eldi kelaboap, eldi maboap, eldi kelmaboap, eldi aeag wamek nimiap, eldi phamap piek.
Esauri ilipsae laploa piognena, sindinge saeagha pham maikno wamogpa, sin ilipsaeap nhon nikag wamnep kom. Ane sembe eldori ilipsae laploa piog.
Ane sembe Esau, si nhon Edom, Seir yimag ko'oro piog.
Piogti, Esauri nimi likto Edom nimi yina liksiogne ane.
Esau, si nhon Edom, elmabona: Esauri kel Adari Elifas mangkaog. Esauri kel Basmatti Rehuel mangkaog.
Ada elauyabona
Ada ela'ange Esau. Esauri me Elifas. Elifasti mabona: Teman, Omar, Sepho, Gaetam, apna Kenasap.
Elifasti kel Timna tognoro torop keldi mena Amalek. Si lepsiap nang ini sikinisag sikinauna Esauap Adaap.
Basmat elauyabona
Basmat ela'ange Esau. Esauri me Rehuel. Rehuelti mabona: Nahat, Serah, Siama apna Misaap. Anena Esau elkel Basmat elau yabo.
Oholibama elauyabona
Esauri kel Oholibama ilisag Sibeon. Sibeon elme Ana. Oholibamana Ana elmangkel agha Esauri tobog. Oholibamari Esau sembe mangkahiogne: Yeus, Yaelam apna Korahap.
Nimi sisa sikini taeknang ane

Esauri mangahirobari sikini yabo tangto piek sisana ane. Elifas Esauri me yandonge. Elifas pone sikini taog. Nimi sisa taeknena: Teman, Omar, Sefo, Kenas, Korah, Gaetam, apna Amalek nimi sisa sikini taek. Esauri kel Adari Elifas mangkaogpa, Elifasti liksiogne undo wamek.

Rehuel ponekona, Esau elkel Basmatti mangkarogne. Nimi sisa sikini yabo taek nimina: Nahat, Serah, Siama, apna Misaap nimi sisa sikini taek. Esauri kel Basmatti Rehuel mangkaogpa, Rehueldi liksiogne undo wamek.
Esauri kel Oholibama. Oholibama ilisag Sibeon. Oholibama ili Ana. Esauap Oholibamaapti liksirekne sindi mabo Yeus, Yaelam, apna Korah nimi sisa sikini taek.
Si lepsiap nang ini Esauri mabo sindam nimi si ahaem uro sikini yabo tangtang piek.
Esau ko'oro pioghag Seir wamek nimi sisana ane
Esau ko'oro Seir pioghag aneko Hori nimi wamekag piog. Horingena Seir poneko
elmabo ane: Lotan, Siobal, Sibeon, Ana,
Dision, Eser, apna Disianap. Edom so'oag Seir elmabo sikini yabo taek.
Lotan elmabona: Hori, apna Hemanap. Lotan ilipsa'elna Timna.
Siobal elmabona: Alwan, Manhat, Ebal, Siepho apna Onamap.
Sibeon elmabona: Aya apna Anaap. Ana poneri iliringe pham yae ua ulamsiogti, aldesag mag lu pobonge ibog.
Ana elmabona Dision apna elmangkel Oholibamaap.
Dision elmabona: Hemdan, Esiban, Yitran apna Keranap.
Eser elmabona: Bilhan, Saawan apna Akanap.
Disian elmabona: Us apna Aranap.
Ane wamlange nenena Hori nimi sikini yabo sisa taek nimi. Sikini yabo sisa taek nimi endana: Lotan nimi sikini, Siobal nimi sikini, Sibeon nimi sikini, Ana nimi sikini,
Dision nimi sikini, Eser nimi sikini, apna Disian nimi sikiniap. Hori nimi sikini yabo sisa ene Hori as mog so'o taneag likto piog.
Edom yubu sia lerop nimi taeknang sisa (36:31-43)
Anam Israel yubu sia lerop nang raja wamna komag, Edom samenag yubu sia lerop nang wamek nangna: Beor elme Bela yubu sia leropne Edom mog so'oag wamek nimi sembe wamog. Eldi as Dinhaba.
Bela tebaogpa, Serah elme Yobab as Bosrange agha Bela lunumna waelbaog.
Yobab tebaogpa, lunumna Husiam waelbaogne Teman nimi sisa agha waelbaog.
Husiam tebaogpa, Bedad elme Hadad lunumna as Awitne agha waelbaog. Hadad poneri Midian nimiap Moab asag agha mal talamekti, oro luknubahiogne.
Hadad tebaogpa, Hadad lunumna as Masrekange Samla waelbaog.
Samla tebaogpa, Samla lunumna Rehobot mag abolagne Syaul waelbaog.
Syaul tebaogpa, Syaul lunumna Akhbor elme Baal-Hanan waelbaog.
Baal-Hanan tebaogpa, Baal-Hanan lunumna Hadar waelbaog. Hadarti asna Pahu. Eldi kel sina Mhetabe'el ili Matred. Mhetabe'el ilisag Mesa'ab.

Edom nimi sikinisang taognena Esau. Nimi sisana: Timna, Alwi, Yetet, Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, Kenas, Teman, Mibsar, Magdiel, apna Iram nimi sisaap. Sin si lepsiap nimi sisa ene ahaem uro, as mog so'o wameka ane babe, nimi si wamla ane saog uro engero piog.

footnotes.text: Si Seir engeropne anena yim siap, nimi si babe engeropne (36:8).
